test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Who among the following Indian athletes won a Gold medal in 2022 Common Wealth Games?

I. Saurav Ghosal

II. Anshu Malik
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saurav Ghosal **and **Anshu Malik** did not win** gold medals** in the **2022 Commonwealth Games.**
 
• India won **23 Bronze medals** in** Commonwealth Games 2022.**
 
• India won a total of **61 medals** in the **Commonwealth Games 2022**.
 
 
• **22 gold,**
 
• **16 silver, and**
 
• **23 bronze​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **In the 2018 Commonwealth Games,** India won a total of** 66 medals** out of which **16 were in shooting.**​
 
• This time** shooting** was not included.
 
• India finished fourth in the medal tally.
 
• **Australia** took** first** place.
 
• **England **finished **second **and Canada** third**.
 
• **New Zealand** finished** fifth**.
